Partnership and investment discussions continued; acquisition outreach resumed in February-April 2021. Competitive bids and diligence in April-May led to final approval, execution and public announcement June 2. The prior private proposal was neither a signed nor publicly definitive agreement at January 1. July amendment clarifies April-May standstill terms without changing the baseline chronology. One original paragraph has a September-October 2021 date amid the 2020 sequence; no eligibility conclusion depends on correcting that apparent internal typo.
